re-quoting after the additional work has already been done
granting discounts with no authority, no limit and no record
acceptance_tests: every accepted return has a written quote or band recorded before work starts
every repricing event has a recorded client approval dated before the extra work was performed
revisit_triggers: repricing events cluster in one rung, which means the ladder's triggers are wrong rather than the clients
concessions rise steadily across a season

base.update_signal: the count and distribution of repricing events and concessions recorded during a season

nodes.definition: Hold one dated go/no-go before intake opens, because in a seasonal business the cost of discovering a missing prerequisite is not a delay but a lost year. The gate walks the list item by item and records an owner and a date against each: every person who will be compensated for preparing returns holds a current authorization in their recorded class; the electronic filing authorization is granted, current and proved by a live test transmission; the served-states list and any state filing enrollments are satisfied and dated; the written information security program exists with individual credentials issued and a removal path defined; the software is installed, updated, converted from prior-year files and rehearsed; the tier ladder and quoting rule are published and the intake questionnaire actually classifies against them; the fee-collection mechanisms and their client-borne costs are written and disclosable; the peak ceiling, cutoff dates and override authority are published; and the engagement paperwork the practice uses is in place. Each item is either satisfied with a date and an owner or carried as a named open risk with a mitigation and a review date. Nothing passes on the strength of an assurance that it will be fine by February.

included: the item list across authorizations, systems, pricing, capacity and paperwork
an owner and a date per item
the open-risk carry with mitigation and review date
the evidence each item is proved by
excluded: in-season quality control of the returns themselves, owned by the return workflow knowledge base
client-facing season-opening communication and re-engagement, owned by the returning-client knowledge base
any assertion that a given item is currently required, which each item's own unit sends to the authority

pros.claim: One dated gate catches long-lead prerequisites while there is still calendar left to repair them
pros.example: an expiring credential found in November rather than in the first week clients arrive

cons.claim: Held too late the gate becomes a formality, and held too early it passes items that decay before the season opens
cons.example: a security review completed in summer, before the seasonal staff who will actually use the systems have even been hired

failure_modes: passing the gate with open items and no mitigation or review date
checking the software thoroughly and the authorizations not at all
running the gate once and never re-checking items that expire between the gate and the season
acceptance_tests: every gate item is dated, owned and either satisfied or carried as a named open risk with a mitigation
the live test transmission and the tier classification dry-run are both evidenced, not asserted
revisit_triggers: any gate item lapses or changes between the gate and the season
a new service, state, system or staff member is added after the gate has been held

base.update_signal: any prerequisite lapsing, or a post-season review showing an item that should have been on the gate list

nodes.definition: Use the finished season's own record to correct the assumptions the practice was built on, in the weeks straight after the deadline while the evidence is still warm and before the next year's commitments are signed. The recalibration compares, assumption by assumption: planned against realized segment mix; assumed against recorded minutes per tier including the long tail; the modelled peak ceiling against what was actually completed and which constraint actually bound; quoted against collected fee per tier after concessions and repricing events; the planned arrival curve against the observed one; and the budgeted cost schedule against what was really paid and when. Each divergence produces exactly one of four outcomes, written down: change the tier triggers, change the inputs to the pricing mechanism, change the capacity or cutoff, or accept the divergence as noise with a stated reason. This unit is deliberately inward-facing - it recalibrates the practice's own economics and its setup decisions. How clients are followed up, thanked, retained and re-engaged for next season belongs to the returning-client knowledge base and is not attempted here.

included: the planned-against-realized comparison set
the four permitted outcomes per divergence
the timing rule that puts the review before next season's commitments
the record that makes next season's attribution possible
excluded: client-facing post-season follow-up, thank-you contact, next-year positioning, retention and referral work, all owned by the returning-client and off-season revenue knowledge base
per-return quality post-mortems, owned by the return workflow knowledge base
any benchmark comparison against other practices' published figures

pros.claim: Doing the comparison while the season's records are fresh is the only moment the practice has cheap and honest evidence about its own assumptions
pros.example: discovering that the rung assumed to be most profitable in fact absorbed the most unbilled minutes

cons.claim: The recalibration lands in the weeks when everyone in the practice is exhausted and least willing to look squarely at what went wrong
cons.example: an owner who defers the review to autumn and then reconstructs the season from memory rather than from records

failure_modes: reviewing revenue without the minutes that produced it
changing every parameter at once so nothing can be attributed after the next season
skipping the review entirely after a good year
acceptance_tests: each planned-against-realized comparison is recorded with an explicit change-or-accept decision and a reason
the review is completed before the next season's licence, lease and staffing commitments are made
revisit_triggers: a mid-season signal contradicts a recalibration decision made after the last one
a rule change invalidates an assumption before the next season starts

base.update_signal: the completed season's mix, minutes, throughput, collections and cost records set against what was planned

edges.why_related: what the charter says the practice will sign determines which authorization class its people must actually hold
the never-sell list in the charter is what the selling constraints operationalise channel by channel
state obligations sit on top of federal standing and can only be assessed once the federal class is known
the provider application is made by a firm whose principals' preparer standing must already be established
the referred-out list is drawn first at the credential boundary, because representation work above the class can never be accepted
safeguarding conditions attached to provider status are part of what the written security program must satisfy
how much credit due-diligence exposure to carry is a narrowing of the perimeter already drawn, not a separate appetite
a work signature is built per candidate segment, so the candidates must be named and described first
committing to a segment without its work signature is committing to an unmeasured cost per return
the delivery model is chosen against the committed segment's observed behaviour rather than in the abstract
the committed segment fixes which form and schedule classes the package must cover before anything else is weighed
a capacity ceiling is meaningless until the weeks it must survive are identified from the arrival curve
the cutoff date is derived from the ceiling: it is the point at which promised work would exceed what can be finished accurately
a fee mechanism must at minimum carry the year-round cost base that the season alone has to fund
the ladder is the chosen architecture made concrete, so the mechanism must be picked before the rungs are cut
a quote and a repricing trigger can only exist once there are rungs and triggers to quote from and move between
the written program, individual credentials and removal path are gate items that must be evidenced before intake opens
the recalibration measures the season the gate allowed to start, and re-scopes the gate list for the next one
a segment whose typical return sits outside the perimeter can be mapped as context but never as a servable candidate
edges.risk_of_conflict: an attractive segment is mapped as available when the practice cannot sign its returns

edges.why_related: the signature's form and schedule classes act as a disqualifier on any package that does not cover them, whatever it costs
edges.risk_of_conflict: a cheaper package is chosen and a needed form class is discovered mid-season

edges.why_related: the stance removes refund amount from the set of legal pricing inputs and requires that a quote be issuable before work starts
edges.risk_of_conflict: a fee mechanism that is easiest to sell is one the stance forbids

edges.why_related: refund-funded collection is permitted only under plain advance disclosure and never as the default offered to a client who could pay
edges.risk_of_conflict: the collection mechanism that maximises early cash is the one most easily mis-sold

edges.why_related: the served-states list bounds the accepted list: a return needing an unserved state is outside the perimeter regardless of technical skill
edges.risk_of_conflict: a competent preparer accepts a return in a state the practice has no standing in

edges.why_related: returns carrying a due-diligence interview class need their own rung, because their minutes and exposure do not follow form count
edges.risk_of_conflict: interview-heavy returns priced on the base rung lose money and carry the practice's largest per-return exposure

edges.why_related: the committed segment's deadline positions and document-issuance patterns are what actually produce this practice's arrival curve
concentration of arrivals into a few weeks is the direct cause of the off-season trough the reserve exists to bridge
the model determines the interruption load and the number of client-facing steps, which is what sets the achievable peak-week ceiling
installation, prior-year conversion and a rehearsed test filing are gate items that must be finished in that order before intake
the cutoff dates and override authority must be published before the gate can pass, because they are part of what clients are promised
realized minutes and collected fee per rung are the only honest evidence about whether the fee mechanism's inputs were the right ones
what was actually completed in the peak week and which constraint really bound replaces the modelled ceiling's assumptions
the season's job records convert estimated signatures into observed ones, including the long tail nobody believed in year one
repricing events clustering on one kind of return are evidence that a rung's triggers are cut in the wrong place
the off-season trough creates real pressure to sell whatever produces cash earliest, which is exactly the product class the stance most restricts
edges.resolution_rule: the stance wins without exception: refund-funded products stay opt-in and fully disclosed, and a cash shortfall is met with deposits at intake, a larger measured reserve or fewer year-round commitments, never by defaulting clients into a product they did not need

edges.why_related: the segment with the most attractive economics is frequently the one whose returns sit just outside what the practice can competently sign today
edges.resolution_rule: the perimeter wins until competence is acquired and evidenced: the segment may be committed to only after the training, the named reviewer or the referral partnership that makes its returns acceptable is actually in place and dated

edges.why_related: peak throughput is bought by shortening client contact, and the due-diligence obligation class is precisely a requirement to lengthen it
edges.resolution_rule: the obligation class is fixed and the ceiling moves: interview time for a claim class is never compressed, so the practice lowers accepted volume, lengthens the appointment or applies the cutoff instead

edges.why_related: late arrivals are disproportionately complex, high-fee returns, so the cutoff sends away exactly the work the pricing architecture values most
edges.resolution_rule: the cutoff holds because accuracy cannot be bought with fee: scarce late capacity is allocated by published rule and priced through the tier ladder in advance, never by accepting work past the ceiling and hoping

edges.why_related: both decompose a return into its work drivers, but the signature measures them in minutes and documents while the ladder converts them into intake-visible triggers

conflict_axes.name: peak_throughput_vs_required_client_contact
conflict_axes.description: Everything that raises returns-per-week in the crush works by cutting the time spent with the client, and part of that time is a fixed obligation rather than an efficiency to be found.
poles: finish as many returns as possible in the peak weeks
hold the interview and verification time each claim class requires
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat obligated contact time as fixed and move the ceiling instead - fewer accepted returns, longer appointment blocks, an earlier cutoff or more reviewer hours

conflict_axes.name: revenue_in_front_of_you_vs_competence_perimeter
conflict_axes.description: The most tempting returns to accept are the ones just past the line the practice drew in a calmer month, and the temptation peaks exactly when judgement is worst.
poles: take the complex return that walked in
refuse and refer anything outside the written perimeter
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the written perimeter decides at the counter; expansion happens between seasons with training or a named reviewer attached, never mid-crush

conflict_axes.name: niche_depth_vs_concentration_risk
conflict_axes.description: Depth in one segment compounds checklists, review speed and referral density, and simultaneously ties the practice's fate to one community, one employer or one rule set.
poles: commit deeply to one segment
spread across several segments for resilience
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: commit to a primary segment with one adjacent segment as ballast, and write down the watch signals and the evidence that would justify reopening the decision

conflict_axes.name: fixed_licence_cost_vs_per_return_cost
conflict_axes.description: An unlimited licence is cheaper per return above a volume the practice cannot yet prove it will reach, while per-return pricing is safer at low volume and punitive at high volume.
poles: buy the flat seasonal licence
pay per return until volume is proved
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: compute the break-even from the practice's own expected mix, choose the variable model while volume is unobserved, and re-test the break-even at every post-season recalibration

conflict_axes.name: quotable_simplicity_vs_complexity_sensitivity
conflict_axes.description: A single headline price is the easiest thing to advertise and the fastest way to make careful clients subsidise chaotic ones; complexity-sensitive pricing is fair and harder to explain.
poles: advertise one simple price
price from intake-classified complexity tiers
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep few enough rungs to state in a sentence, publish what each includes and excludes, and quote from the rung before any work begins

conflict_axes.name: reachability_for_cash_poor_filers_vs_fee_certainty
conflict_axes.description: Requiring payment before transmission protects the practice and excludes the clients whose only money is the refund; refund-funded products include them and take a real bite out of what they receive.
poles: collect at or before delivery
offer a refund-funded route so cash-poor filers can be served
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: offer both, present the direct payment route first, disclose the product's client-borne cost plainly and in advance, and never make the refund-funded route the default

conflict_axes.name: walkin_visibility_vs_asynchronous_control
conflict_axes.description: A street presence generates trust and unscheduled traffic; a portal-first model generates control over when work happens and loses the people who will never upload anything.
poles: office presence with drop-in access
virtual portal-first delivery
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the committed segment's observed behaviour decide, and if a hybrid is chosen, staff and rehearse both paths rather than running one badly

conflict_axes.name: security_discipline_vs_client_convenience
conflict_axes.description: Clients reliably offer the least secure route - a photograph by message, a shared login, a document to a personal address - and the practice holds the most sensitive package they own.
poles: accept documents however the client finds easiest
hold every document to the permitted secure channel
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the permitted channel is non-negotiable and the convenience is engineered inside it, with a staffed path for clients who genuinely cannot use the portal

conflict_axes.name: growth_ambition_vs_authorization_ceiling
conflict_axes.description: Client demand routinely runs ahead of what the practice's credential class and state standing permit it to do, and the standing takes months or years to raise.
poles: serve what clients ask for now
serve only what the current authorization class covers
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the ceiling and build referral relationships for what sits above it, while treating the demand pattern as the business case for the next credential or registration

conflict_axes.name: published_cutoff_vs_late_high_value_work
conflict_axes.description: The returns that arrive last are often the most complex and the most profitable, and they arrive when there is least capacity to do them properly.
poles: hold the published cutoff
make an exception for a valuable late return
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the line and route the work onto a properly explained extension path; if late complex work is the practice's real business, raise next season's ceiling for it rather than overriding this season's cutoff

edge_cases.description: A returning client brings a corrected income statement two days before the deadline for a return that was finished, signed and billed a month earlier
edge_cases.trigger: a payer issues a corrected document late in the season
edge_cases.mitigation: hold a named reserve of peak-week capacity for corrections, treat reopened work as new work under the quoting rule, and log the correction so the next season's curve includes the tail

edge_cases.description: The electronic filing provider application is still pending weeks before the season opens
edge_cases.trigger: an identity or suitability step in the application takes longer than the practice planned for
edge_cases.mitigation: carry it on the gate as an open risk with a decision date, confirm status with the authority rather than assuming, and be willing to delay opening or to limit intake rather than promising transmission the practice cannot perform

edge_cases.description: A prospect asks the practice to match a competitor's promise of a larger refund and offers to move their whole family's returns
edge_cases.trigger: a competitor advertises on refund outcome and the prospect treats it as the comparable
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse the outcome promise explicitly, explain what the practice sells instead, quote the tier plainly, and accept losing the work rather than implying a position the documentation would not support

edge_cases.description: A long-standing client moves to a state the practice has not registered in or enrolled for
edge_cases.trigger: a client relocates or takes work across a state line between seasons
edge_cases.mitigation: check the served-states list before accepting the return, decide deliberately between adding the state in the off-season and referring the client out with a warm handoff, and never prepare it first and check afterwards

edge_cases.description: A client who booked in January still has not supplied documents when the completeness date passes
edge_cases.trigger: an early booking with a late, incomplete document set
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the cutoff from document completeness rather than from the booking date, having stated that rule in writing when the booking was taken, and move the client onto the extension path with a clear explanation

edge_cases.description: The software vendor changes its licensing or support terms after the practice has committed its segment and marketing to the package
edge_cases.trigger: a vendor repricing, bundling change or ownership change announced between seasons
edge_cases.mitigation: re-run the break-even against the new terms during the off-season only, price the conversion cost of switching honestly, and never begin a migration once live returns exist for the season

edge_cases.description: A seasonal preparer resigns in the middle of the peak weeks, taking both their capacity and their system access with them
edge_cases.mitigation: revoke the individual credential the same day under the written program, recompute the ceiling immediately and apply the cutoff earlier rather than promising work the remaining hours cannot finish

edge_cases.description: A client insists on sending identification documents as photographs to a personal message thread because the portal is inconvenient
edge_cases.trigger: client resistance to the secure channel during the busiest week
edge_cases.mitigation: decline the channel without exception, offer the staffed alternative built for clients who cannot use the portal, and record the refusal so the pattern informs the next model review

edge_cases.description: Preparation reveals an undisclosed business or rental that moves the return two rungs above what was quoted
edge_cases.trigger: facts discovered during preparation that the intake questionnaire did not surface
edge_cases.mitigation: stop work at the trigger, re-quote the correct rung and obtain recorded approval before continuing, and feed the missed fact back into the intake questionnaire for the next season

edge_cases.description: A visibly distressed client asks for the fee to come out of their refund and does not appear to understand what the product will cost them
edge_cases.trigger: a cash-poor or vulnerable filer meeting a refund-funded collection option
edge_cases.mitigation: slow down, state the product's own cost in money rather than as a convenience, offer the direct payment and deposit routes first, and record that the comprehension check happened

edge_cases.description: A credential renewal or continuing-education deadline falls inside the peak weeks
edge_cases.trigger: a renewal cadence that does not respect the filing calendar
edge_cases.mitigation: pull every renewal and education obligation forward into the pre-season gate with its own date and owner, and treat an unrenewed authorization as a stop condition rather than an administrative detail

edge_cases.description: The single large employer or community the niche was built around restructures between two seasons
edge_cases.trigger: a concentrated client base losing its anchor
edge_cases.mitigation: treat it as the evidence the commitment decision named as reversal-worthy, rebuild the arrival curve and the reserve against the reduced base, and reopen the adjacent-segment choice in the off-season rather than improvising during the peak

workflow.action: Write the practice charter and its never-sell list
workflow.description: Fix the revenue unit, the client class, the season as the operating period and the three things the practice will never sell, with every regulatory class marked for verification
workflow.gate: the revenue unit, client class, season boundary and never-sell list are written, and each named requirement class carries a verify-with-the-authority instruction

workflow.action: Establish and record preparer authorization standing
workflow.description: Record each person's authorization class, its status, its renewal and education obligations and the prepare-versus-represent boundary, then build the served-states list on top of it
workflow.artifact: authorization register with the dated served-states list
workflow.gate: every person who will be paid to prepare has a current recorded class, and each served state names the requirement class satisfied and the date it was verified

workflow.action: Start the electronic filing authorization in the off-season
workflow.description: Submit the provider application months ahead, track its status, register the firm-level update duties and set up transmission-account monitoring
workflow.artifact: authorization file with application status, ownership record and monitoring cadence
workflow.gate: the authorization is granted and a live test transmission has completed, or the gap is carried as an open risk with a decision date

workflow.action: Draw the competence perimeter and set the due-diligence exposure limit
workflow.description: Write the accepted, conditional and referred-out class lists with their controls and referral destinations, and state how much credit due-diligence exposure the practice will carry and at what price and training level
workflow.artifact: perimeter document with referral destinations and exposure limit
workflow.gate: each conditional class names its control, each referred-out class names a destination, and the exposure limit states a time and price allowance

workflow.action: Write the selling constraints before any marketing exists
workflow.description: Set refund-neutral claims, the ban on fear-driven urgency, the vulnerable-filer slow lane and position neutrality as standing rules with refusal consequences
workflow.artifact: selling constraints one-pager used to approve every channel and script
workflow.gate: no claim in any channel references refund size, and the slow-lane rule and comprehension check are stated and known to staff

workflow.action: Map candidate segments and build each one's work signature
workflow.description: Describe candidates by document pattern, arrival timing and incumbent, then convert each into forms, documents, interview minutes, states, review depth and a minutes distribution with its long tail
workflow.artifact: segment map with one work signature per candidate, labelled estimated or observed
workflow.gate: every candidate has an arrival-timing note and a signature whose minutes range is explicitly labelled estimated or observed

workflow.action: Commit to a primary segment and record the reversal cost
workflow.description: Choose the primary and at most one adjacent segment against signature, perimeter, exposure appetite and calendar position, and write what it would cost and what evidence would justify reversing
workflow.artifact: dated commitment memo with reversal cost, watch signals and review season
workflow.gate: the memo names the primary segment, the adjacent one, the reversal cost, the reversing evidence and the season the decision may be reopened

workflow.action: Choose the delivery model and stand up the data-protection program it obliges
workflow.description: Decide office, virtual or hybrid against the committed segment's behaviour and the peak week, then write the security program, name the systems holding client data, issue individual credentials and define the removal path
workflow.artifact: delivery model decision plus the dated written information security program
workflow.gate: the peak-week interruption rule is stated, every client-facing step has been walked end to end, and every person with access holds an individual credential with a removal date

workflow.action: Select, install, convert and rehearse the preparation stack
workflow.description: Screen packages on form coverage for the committed segment, compute the licensing break-even from the practice's own expected mix, then install, update, convert prior-year files and rehearse before intake
workflow.artifact: stack decision record with the coverage check, the break-even computation and a completed conversion test
workflow.gate: coverage is verified in writing before purchase and both the prior-year conversion and a test filing are completed before intake opens

workflow.action: Model the arrival curve, compute the peak ceiling and publish the cutoff
workflow.description: Lay out the season's phases, compute what can pass every stage in the heaviest weeks with a rework reserve, name the binding constraint, then publish the new-client and returning-client cutoff dates with the completeness condition and override authority
workflow.artifact: capacity model with named binding constraint and a published intake cutoff policy
workflow.gate: the ceiling, the binding constraint and the rework reserve are explicit, and the cutoff dates plus completeness condition are published before intake opens

workflow.action: Build the pricing architecture, the tier ladder, the quoting rule and the collection terms
workflow.description: Choose the fee-construction mechanism from the return's real work drivers, cut the rungs on intake-recognisable triggers, fix the pre-work quote and repricing trigger with its concession authority, and write the collection ladder with its disclosures
workflow.artifact: pricing pack containing the tier ladder, the quote and repricing rule and the collection terms
workflow.gate: no pricing input references refund amount, two preparers classify sample intakes identically, and every collection mechanism's client-borne cost is disclosable before the client chooses

workflow.action: Hold the dated pre-season go or no-go
workflow.description: Walk every prerequisite - authorizations, states, security program, software, tiers, cutoff, collection terms, engagement paperwork - and record an owner and date or a named open risk with a mitigation
workflow.artifact: signed readiness gate record with open-risk register
workflow.gate: every item is satisfied with an owner and date or carried as an open risk with a mitigation and review date, and the test transmission and classification dry-run are evidenced

dominance_rules.rule: Current authorization standing dominates every commercial plan
dominance_rules.rationale: preparing, signing or transmitting without the required standing exposes the practice to sanction and can end it, while a delayed launch only costs a season
dominance_rules.trigger: any plan that would have returns prepared, signed or transmitted before an authorization class is confirmed current
dominance_rules.action: stop the plan, verify the class with the authority, and change the opening date or the intake limit rather than the standing

dominance_rules.rule: The honest-offer stance dominates revenue pressure in every channel
dominance_rules.rationale: refund promises, fear-driven urgency and defaulted products destroy exactly the trust that makes a client come back next year, and expose the practice to complaint
dominance_rules.trigger: any proposal to advertise or close on refund size, to use audit fear as a lever, or to make a refund-funded product the default
dominance_rules.action: refuse the proposal and revert to work-based claims, disclosed prices and an opt-in product presented after the direct payment routes

dominance_rules.rule: Obligated client contact time dominates throughput targets
dominance_rules.rationale: the interview and documentation duties attached to certain claim classes are requirements with a per-return penalty class, not efficiencies available to a busy week
dominance_rules.trigger: a peak-week plan that would shorten or skip a required interview to raise returns per day
dominance_rules.action: hold the contact time and lower the accepted volume, lengthen the appointment or apply the cutoff instead

dominance_rules.rule: The written competence perimeter dominates a wanted client
dominance_rules.rationale: signing a return is a personal assertion, and the cost of a return the practice could not competently prepare lands on the client first and the practice second
dominance_rules.trigger: a prospect whose return falls in the referred-out class, however attractive the relationship
dominance_rules.action: decline and refer using the named destination, at peak as much as in January

dominance_rules.rationale: the practice holds the densest identity package a household owns, and one improvised channel can compromise many clients at once
dominance_rules.trigger: a client offering documents through an unsecured channel, or any request to share a login
dominance_rules.action: route the client to the permitted channel or the staffed alternative, and decline the document rather than accept it unsafely

dominance_rules.rule: Finishable capacity dominates the intake calendar
dominance_rules.rationale: work accepted beyond the ceiling is not extra revenue but extra risk, paid for in rushed reviews and reopened returns
dominance_rules.trigger: arrivals running above the peak-week ceiling
dominance_rules.action: apply the published cutoff and offer the extension path; do not absorb the overflow on the assumption it will fit

dominance_rules.rule: The recorded pre-work quote dominates work in progress
dominance_rules.rationale: a fee agreed after the work is done is not a fee agreed at all, and silent absorption teaches the practice to mis-price the same return every year
dominance_rules.trigger: preparation reveals a fact that moves the return to a higher rung
dominance_rules.action: stop, re-quote the correct rung, record the client's approval, and only then continue

dominance_rules.rule: The practice's own observed records dominate outside figures
dominance_rules.rationale: borrowed minutes, prices and volumes describe somebody else's clients and hide exactly the local variation that decides whether this practice survives its peak
dominance_rules.trigger: an assumption taken from a benchmark, an article or a competitor conflicts with the practice's own logged minutes, arrivals or collections
dominance_rules.action: use the observed figure, mark the borrowed assumption retired, and note the date the observation was made

dominance_rules.rule: Long-lead prerequisites dominate short-lead polish in off-season scheduling
dominance_rules.rationale: authorizations and conversions are gated by other people's timelines, while marketing and price presentation can be finished in days
dominance_rules.trigger: off-season time is scarce and several tasks compete for it
dominance_rules.action: give calendar first to the provider authorization, state registrations, software conversion and training, and let branding and copy wait

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm authorization and electronic filing standing before spending on premises, branding or marketing
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a launch that has bought an audience it is not yet permitted to serve, with the whole spend stranded for a season

anti_rework_rules.rule: Draw the competence perimeter before mapping or courting segments
anti_rework_rules.prevents: committing marketing and learning to a segment whose returns the practice cannot competently sign, then unwinding it in public

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build each segment's work signature before selecting software
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering a missing form class or an unworkable module after conversion, when switching costs a whole off-season

anti_rework_rules.rule: Commit to the segment before choosing the delivery model or signing for premises
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a lease or a portal-only model that the committed client base will not actually use, paid for all year

anti_rework_rules.rule: Model the arrival curve and the peak ceiling before publishing any turnaround promise
anti_rework_rules.prevents: promising a turnaround the peak week cannot deliver and paying for it in rushed reviews, corrections and refunds

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the tier triggers before advertising any price
anti_rework_rules.prevents: advertised prices that have to be renegotiated with every second client because the rung was never defined

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the collection mechanisms and their disclosures before the first client is quoted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: improvised fee arrangements at delivery and refund-funded products sold by default to clients who could simply have paid

anti_rework_rules.rule: Stand up the security program and issue individual credentials before hiring any seasonal help
anti_rework_rules.prevents: shared logins and untraceable access that cannot be revoked cleanly once the season ends

anti_rework_rules.rule: Publish the intake cutoff before intake opens rather than announcing it during the crush
anti_rework_rules.prevents: case-by-case refusals in April that read as arbitrary, damage relationships and still leave the practice overloaded

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the post-season recalibration before signing next season's licence, lease and staffing commitments
anti_rework_rules.prevents: repeating a mispriced tier or an unreachable ceiling for a second year because the evidence arrived after the commitments

iteration_protocol.trigger: realized peak-week completions land below the modelled ceiling, or the constraint that actually bound was not the one named
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the ceiling from logged minutes per stage, rename the binding constraint and reset the cutoff dates before the next season opens

iteration_protocol.trigger: repricing events or unbilled minutes cluster on one kind of return
iteration_protocol.action: re-cut that rung's triggers and re-test classification agreement on sample intakes rather than adjusting prices client by client

iteration_protocol.trigger: an authority or a served state publishes a change to preparer identification, filing authorization, due-diligence duties or data-protection obligations
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the affected class at source, update the register and the written program, and re-run the corresponding readiness gate item with a new date

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint, confusion or comprehension-failure pattern appears among vulnerable filers or around a fee product
iteration_protocol.action: review the scripts and the product presentation order, reinforce the slow lane and the comprehension check, and withdraw any offer that cannot be explained plainly

iteration_protocol.trigger: the season's realized segment mix diverges materially from the committed segment
iteration_protocol.action: test whether the divergence is drift or evidence against the commitment, and either re-aim acquisition or reopen the commitment in the off-season with the reversal cost restated

iteration_protocol.trigger: collections land later or lower than the schedule assumed, or a year-round commitment is added or repriced
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the due-date against collection-date schedule and restate the minimum off-season reserve before any new commitment is signed

iteration_protocol.trigger: return volume crosses the computed licence break-even, or the vendor changes pricing, support or ownership
iteration_protocol.action: re-run the break-even against the new terms during the off-season only, and price the conversion cost honestly before any switch
run the full planned-against-realized recalibration while the records are fresh, record a change-or-accept decision per divergence, and feed the result into the next readiness gate

priority_rationale: The frame nodes come first because nothing else is decidable until the practice knows what it may sign and file, what it refuses to sell, which returns are inside its competence and how client data will be held; segment mapping, work signatures and the commitment decision follow because every downstream number is denominated in the shape of one segment's return; delivery model, software and collection mechanics come next because they are bought against the committed segment and are expensive to change once live returns exist; the arrival curve, peak ceiling, cost shape and cutoff then convert the season's compression into the practice's real constraints; pricing architecture, tiers and the quoting rule sit on top of those constraints because a fee that ignores them cannot survive a peak; and the readiness gate and post-season recalibration close the loop, one proving the practice may open and the other correcting the assumptions it opened on.
